customers.name: Software Founder Planning an Ownership Transition
customers.description: An owner of an established software or digital technology company considering a buyout, partial liquidity, succession, or a pre-exit partnership. This is a proposed persona, not an identified Vortex client.
careAbout: A partner who understands the business
Certainty over seller proceeds and company growth funding
An agreed role, culture, and decision rights after closing
winsThem: Candid fit decisions before expensive diligence
Specific operating support and credible founder references
A clear distinction between liquidity today and retained future exposure
theirFear: Losing control without understanding reserved matters
A late price change or failed financing
Disrupting employees and customers during transition

top.name: Agreed growth milestones funded
top.description: Milestones due in the agreed planning window that have adequate committed funding and accepted delivery evidence.

branches.name: Runway adequacy
branches.description: Projected months of cash remaining under the approved operating case; decision diagnostic, not a guaranteed survival period.

children.name: Cash forecast reliability
children.description: Forecast periods within the company-agreed tolerance against reconciled actual cash.

children.name: Cash forecast error
children.description: Absolute forecast-versus-actual ending cash variance divided by forecast cash, with zero-denominator cases disclosed.

children.name: Cash evidence freshness
children.description: Days since the last reconciled cash position used in the runway model.

children.name: Financing readiness
children.description: Needed financing decisions with complete evidence before their agreed decision date.

children.name: Funding decision lead time
children.description: Days between a recorded financing decision and the projected cash-need date; negative means late.

children.name: Uncommitted funding gap
children.description: Cash required by the approved case minus existing cash and contractually committed financing.

branches.name: Founder capital alignment
branches.description: Financing milestones whose economic and governance terms remain within the founder's agreed boundaries.

children.name: Ownership clarity
children.description: Share classes and instruments with an agreed, reconciled economic and voting-rights record.

children.name: Unresolved capitalization discrepancies
children.description: Differences between the company register, signed instruments, and modeled fully diluted ownership.

children.name: Unmodeled dilution exposure
children.description: Potential fully diluted ownership from instruments omitted from the approved financing scenario.

children.name: Milestone evidence quality
children.description: Milestones whose outcome is supported by agreed customer and delivery evidence.

children.name: Customer retention evidence coverage
children.description: Relevant recurring-revenue cohorts with an agreed retention definition and usable source data.

children.name: Product milestone acceptance
children.description: Due product milestones accepted against agreed customer-value and delivery criteria.

top.name: High-growth investment thesis delivery
top.description: Due thesis milestones achieved with reviewed evidence, evaluated by company and investment cohort.

branches.name: Capital allocation discipline
branches.description: Follow-on decisions meeting mandate, reserve, and downside-review conditions.

children.name: Reserve coverage
children.description: Approved follow-on needs covered by allocated available reserves, by fund and currency.

children.name: Unreserved approved follow-ons
children.description: Approved but unfunded follow-on needs without an allocated reserve source.

children.name: Reserve forecast age
children.description: Days since the reserve forecast was reconciled to approved decisions and current cash needs.

children.name: Downside readiness
children.description: Financing cases with a reviewed no-new-capital operating scenario.

children.name: Fallback plans approved
children.description: Material funding gaps with a management-approved fallback and decision date.

children.name: Late funding escalations
children.description: Funding needs first escalated after their agreed review threshold.

branches.name: Evidence-backed company progress
branches.description: Company progress claims supported by the agreed measurement basis.

children.name: Growth quality
children.description: Reported growth reconciled by organic, acquisition, price, and currency effects.

children.name: Recurring revenue reconciliation gaps
children.description: Unexplained differences between source contracts/billing and reported recurring revenue.

children.name: Retained cohort revenue
children.description: Revenue retained from the same starting customer cohort over the agreed period.

children.name: Delivery efficiency
children.description: Accepted milestone outcomes relative to the agreed resource budget; interpreted by company rather than pooled indiscriminately.

children.name: Milestone cost variance
children.description: Actual intervention cost versus approved budget for comparable completed milestones.

children.name: Repeat milestone deferrals
children.description: Milestones deferred more than once without a revised evidence-backed thesis.

branches.name: Operating execution resilience

children.name: Technology delivery quality

children.name: Customer-impacting incidents

children.name: Leadership and integration readiness

children.name: Overdue integration dependencies

top.name: Portfolio operating cash generation

branches.name: Operating earnings quality

children.name: Recurring commercial contribution

children.name: Gross contribution margin

children.name: Unprofitable contract exposure

children.name: Operating cost discipline
children.description: Controllable operating costs within the management-approved case, subject to customer-service safeguards.

children.name: Operating cost variance

children.name: Unplanned integration spend

branches.name: Cash conversion quality

top.name: Net distributions to paid-in capital (DPI)
top.description: Cumulative net distributions to the investor divided by paid-in capital on the same investor/fund cash-flow basis and date; undefined before paid-in capital exists.

branches.name: Realized investor cash
branches.description: Cumulative cash distributions actually received by the investor, reconciled separately from unrealized value.

children.name: Realization proceeds available
children.description: Settled fund realization proceeds available after the applicable obligations and reserves.

children.name: Settled investment proceeds
children.description: Bank-confirmed realization proceeds received by the fund; excludes announced deals and uncollected earn-outs.

children.name: Realization deductions
children.description: Documented costs, debt settlement, reserves, and other deductions from realization proceeds before investor entitlements.

children.name: Distribution execution quality
children.description: Approved distribution instructions settled accurately by the contractual date.

children.name: Overdue distributions
children.description: Approved investor entitlements past their contractual payment date and not settled.

children.name: Distribution reconciliation exceptions
children.description: Unresolved differences between approved entitlements, notices, and bank settlement.

branches.name: Paid-in capital transparency
branches.description: Investor contributions and associated return calculations with a reconciled, disclosed cash-flow basis.

children.name: Contribution ledger integrity
children.description: Capital contributions reconciled to the investor, fund, bank date, and purpose.

children.name: Unreconciled contributions
children.description: Cash contributions not matched to authoritative investor and vehicle records.

children.name: Cash-flow dating exceptions
children.description: Unresolved transaction-date or currency inconsistencies affecting performance calculations.

children.name: Return interpretation quality
children.description: Report packages disclosing the required cash-flow basis, valuation date, fees/carry treatment, and realized/unrealized split.

children.name: Unexplained net-to-gross differences
children.description: Return bridge differences not attributable to documented fees, expenses, carried interest, timing, or calculation scope.

children.name: Performance disclosure completeness
children.description: Applicable agreed performance definitions and caveats present in the approved report package.

children.name: Total value to paid-in capital (TVPI)
children.description: Cumulative net investor distributions plus investor-attributable net asset value, divided by paid-in capital on the same investor/fund basis and valuation date. Undefined before paid-in capital exists; includes unrealized value and does not measure available cash.

children.name: Net internal rate of return (IRR)
children.description: Annualized money-weighted return calculated from dated investor contributions, net distributions, and ending net asset value after the applicable fees, expenses, and carried-interest treatment. Disclose currency and financing/timing basis; flag undefined or multiple-solution cases.

top.name: Investor relationship durability
top.description: Eligible investors choosing to continue the relationship when a genuine next-vehicle or extension decision is available; not inferred from inability to redeem.

branches.name: Investor service reliability
branches.description: Agreed reporting and service obligations fulfilled within their contractual windows.

children.name: Reporting dependability
children.description: Report packages accepted for publication without material unresolved review exceptions.

children.name: Reporting timeliness
children.description: Required investor reports issued by their contractual due dates.

children.name: Material report corrections
children.description: Post-publication corrections affecting investor economics or a material disclosure.

children.name: Inquiry resolution quality
children.description: Substantive investor inquiries resolved with accepted evidence within the agreed service window.

children.name: Overdue investor inquiries
children.description: Open substantive inquiries past the agreed response date.

children.name: Repeated clarification requests
children.description: Inquiries reopened because the initial explanation did not resolve the underlying reporting question.

branches.name: Fundraising resilience
branches.description: Documented prospective commitments that remain supportable after investor diligence and acceptance checks.

children.name: Commitment quality
children.description: Accepted commitments with reconciled documents, authority, and funding obligations.

children.name: Admission documentation exceptions
children.description: Unresolved discrepancies affecting an investor's admission or commitment terms.

children.name: Overdue capital calls
children.description: Contractually due investor contributions not settled by their due date.

children.name: Manager service economics
children.description: Contractual management-fee revenue less attributable investor-service and administration costs; fee terms are unknown in this example.

children.name: Investor servicing cost
children.description: Recorded administration and reporting cost attributable to the defined investor cohort.

children.name: Management fee reconciliation gaps
children.description: Differences between contractual fee calculations, approved charges, and accounting records.

top.name: Decision-ready cases at review
top.description: Scheduled investment cases containing the required evidence, downside analysis, conflict review, and authority record at the decision date.

branches.name: Evidence readiness
branches.description: Material thesis assertions supported by current evidence or explicitly marked as unresolved assumptions.

children.name: Diligence closure quality
children.description: Required diligence workstreams reviewed with a documented conclusion and accountable sign-off.

children.name: Critical open diligence findings
children.description: Findings classified as decision-critical and unresolved at the scheduled review.

children.name: Evidence provenance coverage
children.description: Material investment claims linked to dated, permissioned source evidence.

children.name: Decision throughput quality
children.description: Median elapsed time from a complete case to an authorized decision, including recorded pauses without encouraging approval volume.

children.name: Avoidable review rework
children.description: Cases returned for information that should have been present in the agreed initial review package.

children.name: Review waiting time
children.description: Time a complete case awaits an available authorized reviewer.

branches.name: Decision governance integrity
branches.description: Decisions meeting recorded mandate, allocation, conflict, and authority conditions.

children.name: Mandate and conflict resolution
children.description: Cases with all applicable mandate and conflict questions resolved or formally declined before commitment.

children.name: Unresolved allocation conflicts
children.description: Open conflicts about allocating a transaction or follow-on across eligible vehicles.

children.name: Late mandate exceptions
children.description: Requests to override a known mandate boundary after final review has started.

children.name: Approval-to-execution traceability
children.description: Executed transactions whose economic terms and conditions match the final authorized decision.

children.name: Unapproved term deviations
children.description: Executed economic or governance terms deviating from approval without recorded reauthorization.

children.name: Decision record completeness
children.description: Decisions with rationale, approvers, conditions, dissent where applicable, and a versioned evidence set.

top.name: Invested capital within approved thesis
top.description: Invested capital in holdings whose latest review confirms the approved mandate and revised evidence-backed thesis, divided by invested capital under review.

branches.name: Allocation resilience
branches.description: Investment and reserve allocations remaining supportable under the agreed downside scenarios.

children.name: Portfolio concentration discipline
children.description: Allocations within the selected vehicle's documented concentration limits.

children.name: Concentration limit exceptions
children.description: Holdings or exposures above an applicable approved limit without a resolved decision.

children.name: Follow-on reserve shortfall
children.description: Evidence-backed approved follow-on needs exceeding available allocated fund reserves.

children.name: Financing resilience
children.description: Material holdings with reviewed liquidity and financing contingencies.

children.name: Unreviewed refinancing needs
children.description: Financing needs inside the agreed review window without a current contingency assessment.

children.name: Stale downside cases
children.description: Material investment cases not refreshed after a documented trigger or due review date.

branches.name: Realization discipline
branches.description: Exit and hold decisions supported by current company evidence, buyer alternatives, and net-proceeds analysis.

children.name: Valuation challenge quality
children.description: Material valuations with documented methodology, current inputs, and independent reviewer challenge.

children.name: Stale valuation inputs
children.description: Material inputs older than their approved review cadence without a documented justification.

children.name: Unresolved valuation challenges
children.description: Material reviewer objections still open at the reporting approval date.

children.name: Exit execution fidelity
children.description: Completed exits whose proceeds, conditions, and handover reconcile to their authorized sale decision.

children.name: Net proceeds variance
children.description: Actual net realization proceeds minus the latest approved case, separating timing and deferred consideration.

children.name: Uncollected exit consideration
children.description: Contractual sale proceeds due but not settled, including due earn-outs and escrow releases.
